# A repair cafe with fewer bookings

Reduced repair cafe bookings from eight to six and left room for explanations. We repaired the same number of objects and visitors saw what happened. Waiting time was shorter because fewer people arrived with an impossible timetable. [[Repair ideas]] should remember this before we celebrate a full booking sheet as if it were an outcome.
